mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, signaling a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, driving inflation expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of late-cycle instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broadening economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not significantly correlate with the interaction term (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a single month signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, equity valuations are negatively impacted, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of tightening instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k) indicates a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only in non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not significantly correlate with the interaction term in non-recessionary periods (p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: GDP growth (GDPC1) consistently above 2% annually is a reliable indicator of sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods of >2% GDP growth (t-test p > 0.10).
